title: Bank Account Freeze & Cybercrime Representation
description: Step-by-step guidance for individuals and businesses whose bank accounts have been frozen pursuant to cybercrime police notices under Section 91 CrPC / Section 94 BNSS.

steps.title: Bank Communication & Requisition Intake
steps.objective: Determine the exact police station, cyber crime acknowledgement number, and frozen amount.
steps.prompt_guidance: Analyze bank freeze notice and identify investigating cyber crime authority.
steps.expected_output: Requisition assessment memo identifying jurisdictional police station.
steps.verification_gate: Confirm whether freeze covers total account balance or only disputed transaction amount.

steps.title: Transaction Chronology & Legitimacy Evidence
steps.objective: Gather proof that client is bona-fide recipient of funds without involvement in cyber fraud.
steps.prompt_guidance: Construct transaction chronology proving genuine commercial consideration.
steps.verification_gate: Confirm bank statements match invoices and GST returns.

steps.title: Formal Representation to Investigating Officer
steps.objective: Submit legal representation requesting unfreezing of undisputed operating capital.
steps.prompt_guidance: Draft formal representation to Cyber Police explaining bona-fide transaction.
steps.verification_gate: Advocate review; submit via registered post and official email with acknowledgment.

steps.title: Magistrate Application under Section 457 CrPC / BNSS
steps.objective: Approach jurisdictional magistrate court if investigating officer fails to release lien.
steps.prompt_guidance: Draft petition under Section 457 CrPC / Section 503 BNSS for defreezing account.
steps.expected_output: Court application for release of frozen bank account on furnishing indemnity bond.
steps.verification_gate: Ensure client is prepared to furnish bank guarantee or indemnity for disputed amount.
